blueprint.label: v10 mandelbrot display (frozen frame) 64x39
blueprint.description: The mandelbrot display with a constant combinator holding the finished frame already wired in, so it draws the picture with no processor attached. Paste it to check the wiring and the colour packing before hooking up the machine: the image should be GREY. A colour cast means the packed-RGB byte order is not 0xRRGGBB.
